triage.test_level_policy: All augmented selectors use public CPython stdlib APIs only: annotationlib, typing, inspect, dataclasses, math, statistics, and fractions. The F2P tests exercise PEP 649 public annotation helpers, descriptors, re-exports, and typing helpers; the P2P tests exercise unrelated public stdlib behavior and do not target the annotation machinery.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.ForwardRef.evaluate() through the public ForwardRef API.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: PEP 649 requires ForwardRef evaluation to have either owner context or explicit type parameters; evaluating with only globals and locals must raise TypeError rather than resolving a name without annotation-scope context.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.ForwardRef.evaluate() with public typing.TypeVar objects passed as type_params.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Type parameters in annotation scope must be injected into the evaluation namespace so a ForwardRef can resolve a name that is present only as a type parameter.

requirement_sections: Implementation > The `stringizer` and the `fake globals` environment
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.ForwardRef.evaluate() with a public typing.TypeVarTuple starred forward reference.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: The stringizer/ForwardRef machinery must compile starred TypeVarTuple references by wrapping the starred expression, allowing *Ts annotations to evaluate to typing.Unpack[Ts].

PEP 649 mandates that VALUE format is always supported; an __annotate__ function raising NotImplementedError for VALUE is a protocol error and must surface as RuntimeError, not as an empty annotations dict.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.get_annotations() on a public Python function object.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: The helper contract says get_annotations returns a fresh dict on every call; mutating the returned dict must not mutate the object cached __annotations__ dict.
SOURCE format returns the stored forward-reference source text and must not evaluate an undefined name into a runtime value or NameError.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: typing.get_type_hints() on a public class object with format=annotationlib.Format.SOURCE.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Class get_type_hints must pass the requested SOURCE format into annotation retrieval and return source strings directly without evaluating undefined annotation names.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: typing.get_type_hints() on a public class object whose __annotations__ contains a public annotationlib.ForwardRef.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: When SOURCE annotations come from an existing annotations dict rather than a generated __annotate__ function, class get_type_hints must return them directly; entering VALUE-style evaluation converts ForwardRef objects to source strings and changes the public result.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: typing.get_type_hints() on a public function object with format=annotationlib.Format.SOURCE.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Function get_type_hints with SOURCE format must return the source text for parameter and return annotations without entering VALUE/FORWARDREF evaluation.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: typing.get_type_hints() on a public function object whose __annotations__ contains a public annotationlib.ForwardRef.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Function get_type_hints must return SOURCE-format annotations before VALUE-style processing; a legacy ForwardRef value in __annotations__ must be preserved rather than converted to its source string.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: typing.NamedTuple public factory and the PEP 649 public __annotate__ descriptor.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: NamedTuple eager annotation functions must return checked runtime types for VALUE/FORWARDREF but source strings for SOURCE format, as required by the __annotate__ format contract.

requirement_sections: Implementation > The `stringizer` and the `fake globals` environment
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.call_annotate_function() SOURCE fallback through compiler-style public __annotate__ callable semantics.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Exercises SOURCE stringizer behavior for subscription, attributes, calls, starred iteration, binary/reverse binary operators, comparisons, and unary operators using the public call_annotate_function API.

requirement_sections: Implementation > The `stringizer` and the `fake globals` environment
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.call_annotate_function() SOURCE fallback with an f-string format specifier.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: PEP 649 SOURCE reconstruction cannot support string formatting inside annotations; the public fallback must reject that expression instead of returning misleading source text.

requirement_sections: Implementation > The `stringizer` and the `fake globals` environment
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.ForwardRef constructor, evaluate(), repr(), union operators, equality, and syntax validation through public APIs.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Covers documented ForwardRef validation, owner/module namespace inference, cached evaluation, union composition, representation, and expression syntax errors through externally reachable behavior.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: annotationlib.get_annotations() on public classes and objects with malformed or legacy annotations.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Covers public error handling for non-dict __annotate__ results, invalid __annotations__ values, and legacy object annotations that require eval_str processing.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: typing.evaluate_forward_ref() and typing.get_type_hints() VALUE-format behavior on public classes/functions.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Covers VALUE evaluation, NameError preservation, and default Annotated metadata stripping in typing.get_type_hints while leaving SOURCE-specific tests focused on deferred behavior.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.public_surface: inspect.get_annotations re-export and dataclasses import path through public stdlib modules.
test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Pins the public inspect.get_annotations re-export from annotationlib and reloads dataclasses to exercise the annotationlib integration import path.

test.test_pep649_aug.PEP649AugTest.test_.rationale: Reloads the public annotationlib module under coverage and exercises externally reachable fallback paths for ForwardRef construction/evaluation, module re-exports, eval_str annotation lookup, typing forward-reference evaluation, empty NamedTuple annotations, and TypedDict SOURCE/VALUE annotation descriptors.

test.test_pep649_p2p_aug.PEP649P2PAugTes.public_surface: statistics.mean public stdlib API with fractions.Fraction inputs.
test.test_pep649_p2p_aug.PEP649P2PAugTes.rationale: PEP 649 should not affect unrelated statistics behavior; Fraction-preserving mean results pin an adjacent standard-library no-regression surface outside annotation machinery.
